announcements.title: Git worktree management moved out of Oh My Herdr
announcements.body:
### What changed

Oh My Herdr no longer creates, opens, lists, removes, or groups Git worktrees. The related CLI commands, socket API methods, settings, and dialogs have been removed.

### What to do

- Use Worktrunk (`wt`), another Git tool, or your coding agent to manage checkouts.
- Open the resulting directory as a normal Oh My Herdr workspace.

Existing workspace management and Git status display continue to work.
